text.p: Grain and oilseed exports reported by USDA and private export sources.
BARLEY SALE - Iran bought 50,000 tonnes optional-origin feed barley at around $130 per tonne, fob, for May shipment.

RAPESEED MEAL AND WHEATBRAN SALE - A group of South Korean feed milling companies, known as the Feed Buying Group, bought on Tuesday 12,000 tonnes of Indian rapeseed meal at $141.95 a tonne C&F and 14,500 tonnes at $141.60 a tonne C&F from Nidera, traders said. The Feed Buying Group also bought 36,000 tonnes of Indonesian wheatbran pellet at 129.20 won per kilogram C&F from Bogasari, they said.
WHEAT TENDERS - CCC on March 18 seeks up to 25,550 tonnes of wheat for donation to Jordan and Yemen for April 1-25.

- Algeria on Monday tendered for 75,000 tonnes of optional-origin milling wheat for shipment in April and May. CORN AND SOY TENDER - State-owned Taiwan Sugar Corp will tender on Friday for a combined shipment of 20,000 tonnes of U.S. corn and 10,000 tonnes of U.S. soybeans, traders said onTuesday. The tender will specify that sellers have the option for delivery dates, which can be any 20-day window in June. Further details were not available.

SOYBEAN TENDER - Taiwan will tender Wednesday for 54,000 tonnes of U.S. or South American soybeans. The tender does not specify shipping dates for any U.S. ports, making a U.S. purchase all but impossible. Buyers confirmed this was intentional.
CORN TENDER - Taiwan Sugar Corp will tender on Wednesday for 10,000 tonnes U.S. corn. Sellers have the option for delivery dates, which can be any 20-day window in June.
- The CCC seeks up to 4,620 tonnes of No. 2 or better yellow corn for Guatemala. Offers were due on March 19 and the shipment dates were slated for April 3-27.

VEGOIL TENDER - Egypt's Holding Company for Food Industries said on Monday it was seeking up to 45,000 tonnes of assorted vegetable oils for delivery in May 1997. The deadline for all bids was on April 2.

BARLEY TENDER - The South African Wheat Board said on Friday it was offering 25,150 tonnes of feed grade barley for export sale not later than April 30. The board said the barley was five percent more or less seller's option.

RICE TENDER - Syria's General Foreign Trade Organisation for Chemicals and Foodstuffs has issued an international tender to buy 12,000 tonnes of white rice for shipment between April 20 and May 20, a company spokesman said. April 8 is the final date for bids and result will be announced on April 16.

- Costa Rica will seek on March 19 a total of 30,000 tonnes optional origin rough rice which would likely be from the United States or Argentina, U.S. exporters and trade sources said. One U.S. exporter said he believed the paddy rice was slated for June arrival while another said it was set for May.

MARKET TALK - Algeria has excluded France from talks to buy wheat in what French exporters described as possible evidence of new tensions over comments by France's prime minister, grain traders said...Several U.S. exporters said Iraq may have passed offers from its original March 11 tender and will retender later this week for 50,000 tonnes U.S. hard red winter wheat. Delivery dates were slated for May 15-June 15.
